Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing DSHS to establish cost-sharing requirements for recipients of medical programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to costsharing in medical programs; amending RCW74.09.055; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 74.09.055 and 1993 c 492 s 231 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department is authorized to establish copayment, deductible,((or)) coinsurance, or other costsharing requirements for recipientsof any medical programs defined in RCW 74.09.010.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2003.
